/**Function*************************************************************

  Synopsis    [Prepares the data for MSOPs of 4-variable functions.]

  Description []
               
  SideEffects []

  SeeAlso     []

***********************************************************************/
func Cnf_ReadMsops(ppSopSizes *string, ppSops **string) {
    var uMasks [4][2]uint32 = [4][2]uint32{
        { 0x5555, 0xAAAA },
        { 0x3333, 0xCCCC },
        { 0x0F0F, 0xF0F0 },
        { 0x00FF, 0xFF00 },
    };
    var Map [256]byte;
    var pPrev string;
    var pMemory string;
    var pSopSizes string;
    var pSops *string;
    var i, k, b, Size int32;

    // map chars into their numbers
    for  i = 0; i < 256; i++  {
        Map[i] = byte((-1));
    }
    for  i = 0; i < 81; i++  {
        Map[int32(s_Data3[i])] = byte(i);
    }

    // count the number of strings
    for  Size = 0; s_Data4[Size] && Size < 100000; Size++  {}
    assert(Size < 100000, "Size < 100000");

    // allocate memory
    // inlining of macro ABC_ALLOC
    pMemory = ((char *) malloc(sizeof(char) * (size_t)(Size * 75)));
    // copy the array into memory
    for  i = 0; i < Size; i++  {
        for  k = 0; k < 75; k++  {
            if s_Data4[i][k] == ' ' {
                pMemory[i*75+k] = byte((-1));
            } else {
                pMemory[i*75+k] = Map[int32(s_Data4[i][k])]; }
        }
    }

    // set pointers and compute SOP sizes
    // inlining of macro ABC_ALLOC
    pSopSizes = ((char *) malloc(sizeof(char) * (size_t)(65536)));
    // inlining of macro ABC_ALLOC
    pSops = ((char * *) malloc(sizeof(char *) * (size_t)(65536)));
    pSopSizes[0] = 0;
    pSops[0] = nil;
    pPrev = pMemory;
    for  k, i = 0, 1; i < 65536; k++  {
        if pMemory[k] == byte((-1)) {
            pSopSizes[i] = pMemory + k - pPrev; 
            pSops[i++] = pPrev;
            pPrev = pMemory + k + 1;
        }
    }
    *ppSopSizes = pSopSizes;
    *ppSops = pSops;

    // verify the results - derive truth table from SOP
    for  i = 1; i < 65536; i++  {
        var uTruth, uCube, Lit int32;
        for  k = 0; k < pSopSizes[i]; k++  {
            uCube = 0xFFFF;
            Lit = pSops[i][k];
            for  b = 3; b >= 0; b--  {
                if Lit % 3 == 0 {
                    uCube &= uMasks[b][0];
                } else if Lit % 3 == 1 {
                    uCube &= uMasks[b][1]; }
                Lit = Lit / 3;
            }
            uTruth |= uCube;
        }
        assert(uTruth == i, "uTruth == i");
    }
}
